deploybot: starting deploy to prod-eu2 · tag=release/v2.9.0-rc3 · commit=abcdef1234 · started by @release-manager · change-window 02:00-03:00 UTC :rocket:
release-manager: rolling this now; canary targets set to 5% traffic · watch for latency/errors :eyes:
alice: spotting elevated 5xx rate in canary after ~30s, small sample but visible trend · sending logs to #eng-sre :point_right:
observability-bot: alert: canary prod-eu2: 5xx-rate > 2% (1m avg) · dashboard: https://observability/board/9843 · grafana link :link:
deplybot: updated status: canary checks failing · health-check: failing 2/5 instances · pausing further rollout per policy · reason: 5xx spike
bob: can we revert to previous release tag `v2.8.4`? sounds like runtime regression in kv-cache path · @ops-oncall any objections?
ops-oncall: negative impact on customers, +1 for rollback. will monitor infra during revert.
release-manager: do it. execute rollover and pin previous tag. use `deploybot rollback --env prod-eu2 --to-tag v2.8.4 --reason "canary 5xx spike"`
deploybot: rollback initiated · target env=prod-eu2 · initiating revert deploy -> commit=beadfeed00 (tag v2.8.4) · TTL for rollback window 30m · stage: revert-start · action-id=rbk-20240701-01
release-manager: also pin routing so rollout doesn't auto-retry v2.9.0-rc3, add config flag `no-autodeploy=true` for env prod-eu2
deplybot: executing pin: `deploybot pin release v2.8.4 --env prod-eu2` · pin result: success · rollout hold engaged
observability-bot: metric update: 5xx-rate trending down 1m after rollback start · now 0.3% avg · latency back to baseline · link: https://observability/board/9843?from=now-10m
ops-oncall: seeing tx latency drop off and error traces clearing. memory/CPU stable. good sign.
carol: great — can we mark the revert completed and note a follow-up postmortem? I'll take ownership for the PM.
bob: logging snippet from failing canary before rollback:
```
ERROR runtime.kvcache: unexpected null pointer at shard_lookup.go:142
stack: ...
```
alice: will collect full traces and test repro in staging. suspect change in async flushing introduced in rc3
deploybot: rollback complete · revert deploy finished · env=prod-eu2 · to-tag=v2.8.4 · action-id=rbk-20240701-01 · duration=00:01:48 · status=success · notes="pinned v2.8.4, halted v2.9.0-rc3 rollout" :white_check_mark:
release-manager: thanks team. schedule postmortem for 0900 UTC tomorrow, add to calendar and include release notes diff and test matrix. also update the release channel with a short blurb.
carol: adding to calendar now, will open a GH issue for the regression triage and link replay logs.
ops-oncall: leaving monitoring hooks for 2h, will alert if anything regresses. all systems nominal for now.
deploybot: logs & artifacts for revert stored: https://artifacts/deploys/rbk-20240701-01 · to re-open: `deploybot revert reopen <action-id>`
release-manager: moving to postmortem prep. thanks everyone, closing this thread. :handshake:
